stops.date_confidence: the spring 2018 sale and the designated beneficiaries are attested by Wikipedia's David Rockefeller article; press coverage describing it as among the largest single-collection auctions on record is likewise attested there. The often-quoted total of $835,111,344 is NOT carried here: christies.com, artnews.com, theartnewspaper.com and the relevant Wikipedia list articles all failed to load, so no figure was confirmed by a page anyone here read. The exact day is an ordering default within the week of sales. Coordinate corrected from a dossier value 370 m north to Christie's at 20 Rockefeller Plaza, which is the same point as the Rockefeller Center stop.
stops.sun_caveat: year precision: the Sun could be in any sign; the reading above is for the stated (defaulted or conventional) day and should not be trusted
